package rulefixtures

import (
	"encoding/xml"
	"io"
)

// scenario for xml_decoder_without_strict: `xml.NewDecoder(r)` without setting `Strict = false` when processing trusted XML
// fixture polarity: positive; family: performance; severity: info.
type Person struct {
	Name string `xml:"name"`
	Age  int    `xml:"age"`
}

func scenario696Positive(r io.Reader) (*Person, error) {
	var p Person
	decoder := xml.NewDecoder(r)
	if err := decoder.Decode(&p); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return &p, nil
}
